sloka: तानहं समतिक्रान्तमर्यादान्राक्षसाधमान् ।निहनिष्यामि सङ्क्रुद्धः सुरा भवत विज्वराः ।। ७.६.२१ ॥
transliteration: tānahaṁ samatikrāntamaryādānrākṣasādhamān ।nihaniṣyāmi saṅkruddhaḥ surā bhavata vijvarāḥ ।। 7.6.21 ॥

translations.english: I know the demon Sukesha, who is arrogant due to a boon from Shiva, and I also know his sons, among whom Malyavan is the eldest.
